Gaw-La Furia - Prison
(There's no doubt anymore@that the Fury are aliens...)
(But where did they come from, and when did they@reach Earth...? Judging from my age, if it was@about 17 or 18 years ago...)
(Then they came to our planet not just before@the <Aerogators>, but even before <Meteor 3>...)
(Our planet, huh...@When I'm only half Earthling...)
Katia
(She hasn't said a word this whole time...@Can't blame her.)
(I'd suspected my dad was Fury,@but Katia...)
Hey, Touya...
What's that?
The reason we can use@the Cytron Control System... It must be@because we're half Fury.
...So that's what you were thinking about.
If one of my parents...@No, if my father was Fury,@it'd explain the things I've wondered about...
Wondered about?
My father hardly ever talked about his past.@And he was always worried about my health...
Isn't it normal for parents@to worry about their kid's health?
For as long as I can remember...@I had a detailed checkup once a month.@Even though I wasn't sickly...
Maybe that was to keep detailed records on me...@a half-Earthling, half-Fury...
What about you, Touya?
Nothing like that, but...
I see...@If we're half Earthling and half Fury,@then Tenia and Melua too...
(...Probably.)
(Someone's coming...)
Tenia
(She hasn't said a word this whole time...@Can't blame her, really.)
(I'd suspected my dad was Fury,@but Tenia...)
Hey, Touya...
The reason we can use the Cytron Control@System... It's 'cause we're half Fury,@right? It's gotta be...
I think... the one who was Fury@was probably my dad...
What makes you think so?
My dad hardly ever talked about the past,@and he worried about my health@way more than he needed to...
Ever since I was little,@I had a detailed checkup once a month, y'know?@And I'm totally healthy.
(Was he keeping detailed records on Tenia,@a half-Earthling, half-Fury...?)
What about you, Touya?
No, nothing like that for me...
I see...@If we're half Earthling and half Fury,@then Katia and Melua too...
Melua
(I'd suspected my dad was Fury,@but Melua...)
Touya...
The reason we can use@the Cytron Control System... It must be@because we're half Fury, isn't it?
If one of my parents...@No, if my father was Fury,@it'd explain the things I've wondered about.
My father never talked about his past...@And he was always worried about my health...
For as long as I can remember,@I had a detailed checkup once a month.@Even though I wasn't sickly...
Maybe that was to keep detailed records on me...@a half-Earthling, half-Fury...
What about you, Touya?
I see...@If we're half Earthling and half Fury,@then Katia and Tenia too...
(Yeah, no doubt about it...)
Agent
Her Highness summons you.@You'll be masked and restrained, then escorted.
Gaw-La Furia - Grove of Timefaring
Shana-Mia
...Remove their masks.
Sir!
Where is this...?
What is that...?
Before telling you about us, the Fury, I thought@you should see the Grove of Timefaring first.
The Grove of Timefaring...?
It's a cryosleep facility. Inside, tens of thousands@of our people sleep a cold sleep@that lasts for millennia.
C-Cryosleep...?!
And for millennia...!
Long, long ago, we Fury were an empire@that flourished in a star system far, far away.
But a great calamity cost us our home world and@many of our kin. The few who survived escaped@aboard the colossal starship Gaw-La Furia.
And after wandering through space, we reached Earth.
Th-That was a thousand years ago...?!
No, longer... Let's say several thousand years ago.
Th-Then you're descendants of the Fury@who came to Earth long ago...
Not many generations have passed.@Da-Nia, there, actually lived through@the great calamity of the past.
Da-Nia
J-Just how old are you...?!
Not past seventy, I assure you.
What!?
Ah... Could it be, through cryosleep...
Yes... After losing our home world,@we endured the ages by repeating@extremely long periods of cryosleep.
Wh-Why would you do that...
So that someday we ourselves might return home...@and so that our strength and technology wouldn't@be lost over the generations.
But why...
It all began with ruins that existed on our home@world: the Ru-Kuku Vodyu... the Gate of Voda...
And one exists on Earth as well. Tou-Ya, Katia,@you should know of it too... the gate that brings@calamity.
N-No way!
The <Cross Gate>...!
Yes... We sealed the Gate of Voda@beneath the Antarctic ice@and have watched over it for ages.
In preparation for the return of the Vaula,@who once destroyed the Fury home world@and endangered Earth as well...
The Vaula...?
An army of destruction that emerges from the@<Gate of Voda>. Their form differs each time they@appear... but their goal is always the same.
To gather the malice of intelligent life... and@manifest that which endlessly returns the endlessly@expanding universe to the primordial darkness.
Th-That sounds like... the Ruina that Josh@and the others fought in the Sealing War...
Yes, you could say they're the same entity.
We fought the Vaula, and though we paid dearly,@with the protection of Fureim we succeeded@in sealing the Gate of Voda.
Fureim...
The Fury's creator god... a giant deity@crowned with a halo.
A halo, a giant... That's just like Granteed.
Yes... It has been handed down through@our imperial family for ages...@and is said to hold the soul of Fureim.
Isn't that just myth and legend?
Only those of the bloodline of the first Fury@Emperor, called the children of Fureim,@can operate the Throne Units...
In other words, only the head of the imperial@family and their guard... the head of the Shune@house, which has long served as Sentinel Commander.
Shune... That's my dad's...
Yes. Your true name is Tou-Ya Shune... And like@E-Selda, you have the power and the right@to operate the Throne Unit.
B-But when I ride in it, Granteed...
What is that...?
Th-Then you guys are descendants of the Fury@who came to Earth long ago...
Could it be, through cryosleep...
And one exists on Earth as well. Tou-Ya, Tenia,@you should know of it too... the gate that brings@calamity.
Fureim...?
B-But when I ride in it, Granteed...
What could that be...?
Cryosleep...?!
Then are you descendants of the Fury@who came to Earth long ago...?
And one exists on Earth as well. Tou-Ya, Melua,@you should know of it too... the gate that brings@calamity.
But when I ride in it, Granteed...
It can move if one chosen by the Throne Unit rides@alone. I'm one as well, but without training, one@can't fight in it... or draw out its true power.
Training...? Then the first time I rode Granteed@alone, the reason it wouldn't move...@was because I was inexperienced?
However, in the battles after that,@you activated Busker Mode.
That would be proof that you have the same@aptitude as E-Selda... No, an aptitude@even greater than his.
M-Me...? Greater than my dad...?
(When he's half Earthling...@Normally, it would be impossible.)
Perhaps that is exactly why@E-Selda entrusted the Throne Unit to you.
If... If Granteed showed its true power,@what would happen? What would it do?
...It could repel the <Vaula> and seal the@<Gate of Voda>. Once, my father and E-Selda@accomplished exactly that.
I believe the Throne Units can do such things@because the creator god Fureim dwells within them.
(My dad... sealed the Cross Gate...?)
Recently, diffused light was released from the@Gate of Voda... After it rained down on Earth,@<Jevilun> appeared in cities everywhere.
(Does she mean... the <Lamaris>?)
The link between the <Jevilun> and the <Vaula>@isn't yet clear... but it may be a sign@that the Gate of Voda will open again.
Tou-Ya... Please, lend me your strength.@For my people sleeping in the Grove of Timefaring,@and for the people of Earth.
You have the blood of two races in your veins...@No, you may be the very one who can save@both the Fury and Earth...!
(Two races... Earth and the Fury...)
Please... Please, Tou-Ya...
...Your Highness, that's enough. Agents may be@guarding this place, but if the Squires learn of@this, there will be an uproar.
But...
You mustn't. Remember your position.@Great matters lie ahead.
...Understood.
Agents, take these two back to their cell.
Wait! I still have questions!@What's the real reason we were born?!@Why did my dad leave this place?!
Take them away at once.
Tell me, Shana-Mia!
Come on, move!
Gaw-La Furia - Interior
Gu-Landon
I see, so Her Highness...
Fu-Ruu
She seems to intend to persuade him over time...@but who knows if it will work.
That boy is E-Selda's son.
But it's a fact that he's beginning@to draw out the Throne Unit's power.
I know that.@If Her Highness is so attached to him,@we can use him as a leash.
What will you do?
We simply make them Fury...@servants sworn to loyalty to me.@By implanting Cytron receptors.
But that method risks@damaging the brain...
We'll try it on the girl first.@She'll be of use as a test subject@for the Assimilation Plan.
At this rate, Her Highness may truly@join hands with the Steel Dragons.@That must be avoided at all costs.
Karo-Ran
You've brought this matter to me@rather than Gu-Landon...@so you wish to make the first move.
Indeed. I wish to proceed without@Her Highness's knowledge.
Without her knowledge... You mean@I should use Larseilam?
Yes. It's not something I can ask of a knight.@Can you do it?
If it is the Chief Chancellor's command.
First, we should dispose of the counterfeit "key."
According to reports from my subordinates,@they left their base, traveled by sea,@and joined up with the Kurogane.
That's the battleship cooperating@with the Steel Dragons, yes? Will you go?
No, there's someone better suited...@one who bears them an extraordinary grudge.
Then I leave it to you.
Japan - Off Kozu Island
Kurogane Bridge
Rätsel, sir, we're ready to depart.
Then head for the <Tesla Reich Institute>.@We may fly within the Far East Army's airspace.
(Will we receive that item first,@or encounter the Fury first...?)
...It may come down to luck.@They could appear at any time.
You knew exactly what I was thinking.
Heh. We go back a long way.
Then let's begin the briefing.@Call in those two.
Are you really sure about this?
Our unit isn't part of the regular army.@The more fighting strength we have, the better.
Raji
Rätsel, Major Gilliam, a word, please.
And what is that?
Fiona at the Tesla Institute just contacted us.@They've moved up the schedule and will depart@in one hour.
Are the adjustments complete?
No. To save as much time as possible, they'll do@what they can while en route, and the rest@after joining up.
Understood.@Calculate a rendezvous point and inform them.
Understood.
Kurogane Briefing Room
...That's the situation we're facing.@And so, we'd like you to cooperate with us.
You serious?
Even though the Gadisword army@is hostile to the Earth forces...
Most of this ship's crew@once sided with the anti-government forces.@Some even fought us as enemies.
That's right.
But you've got regular Earth soldiers here too.
I intend to follow the judgment@of our commander, Rätsel.
...Let me ask you one thing. What's your goal?
I'd think you understand that after traveling@with the Steel Dragons for a while.
Hmph... You're gonna use us as bait,@or have us guide you if you ever end up@going to <Rabulpaila> again, right?
If we're talking bait, that applies to all of us.@That's why, aside from a few units like the Ariard,@we flew over the sea to join the Kurogane.
(I thought those were strange orders, but I see now.)
I can't deny the part about guiding us...@but even if we do go to Rabulpaila,@I'd like to avoid combat as much as possible.
I doubt Herluga and Golaikunru@feel the same way.
Then we'll have no choice but to@remove the obstacles by force.
Bioroids are one thing, but I'd rather not fight@my own people... Still, I've got a mountain@of things to ask Captain Vort in person.
Besides, I'm not letting Herluga@and the <Rattma> run loose.
As Gilliam said, we have many enemies after us.
Like hell I'm dying in a ditch on this crazy planet.@Anyone who attacks, I'll take on.
Um... I'll cooperate too,@but there's something I'd like to ask.
I understand having someone watch me,@but could you lift my house arrest?
Very well. Fairy Cribia's as well.
Thank you very much!
Kurogane - Hangar
Fairy
I see, so that's how it is...
Now you won't have to feel cooped up@for a while, Fairy.
Yes...
Well, I need to go give the mechanics here@a lecture on the Varga.
Uh, hey...
What?
If you want, I could show you@around the ship later?
Hmm... If I have time, I'd like that.@See you.
Show her around...@We only just boarded the Kurogane ourselves.
Sh-Shut up. It's a Space Noah-class,@so the inside's basically the same as the Hagane.
Jinpu
All right, break's over.@Let's push a little more and get the@Hyper Blast Sword ready to use.
Got it.
Um... Jinpu. There's something@I'd like to ask of you.
What is it?
I want to fight like Sieg and Sally.@Is there any way I could use the Ariard?
What!?
Wh-What are you saying, Fairy?!
I've been trained as a pilot too.
B-But even so...
Your real job was being a bodyguard@for some bigwig, wasn't it?
Please. As one of the people involved,@I don't want to just watch...@I have things I want to ask Vort directly too.
But the Ariard is really pushing it...
Right. If it got stolen,@everything would be for nothing.
Then an unused unit...
No, well... This is a tough one.
...Fairy, you're serious about this, huh?
Yes, of course.
Hey, Jinpu, Akemi.@What if she rode in the cockpit@of the Saber Booster?
Whaaat!?
Whoa, whoa, what're you saying now, too?
But it's way better than putting Fairy@in a Personal Trooper or Armored Module@by herself, right?
Besides, it'd help if she rode in the Saber@Booster and assisted with damage control@and scanning.
But something like that...
Please, let me do it, Akemi.@I won't hold you back.
W-Well, hmm...
I want to see the truth with my own eyes.@That's why I escaped from Rabulpaila.
And if I can, I want to stop@the fighting between Gadisword and Earth.
...All right, Fairy.
Can't be helped... Guess I'll talk to the higher-ups.
Pacific Ocean - Undersea
Rätsel, sir, we're nearing the rendezvous point.
Understood. Order all hands to level one@battle stations, then surface.
Kurogane - Interior
Level one battle stations. Hurry.
Calvina, I have a bad feeling about this.@Please be careful.
A bad feeling? You mean the Fury are coming?
Perhaps it is...
If the Raftclans comes,@it's a chance to get some leads.
But...
You're going to tell me to stay calm, right?@But if he shows up... I don't know what'll happen.
He wasn't the one who attacked@the Ashurey Kreuzer, was he...?
I beat So-Des and avenged everyone.@But something still weighs on me.
What are Al-Van's true intentions?@What did he come to the Ashurey for?@Why was it attacked?
Why did your parents and friends@have to die? Even after getting revenge,@my doubts only keep swirling...
If he shows up now,@I might not be able to hold myself back.
Then I'll protect you.@You and the Bellzelute Brigandi.
Cheeky... No, I'm counting on you.
Calvina...
There's something to do before learning the truth.@Find those two and rescue them...@That may lead us to the answers.
I think so too.
You're sticking with me till the end.@Be ready for it.
Yes, sir.
Calvina... I've got a bad feeling.
You may be right...
If the Raftclans comes, it's a chance@to get some leads. I won't blow it this time.
Really? What if it's the black one?@What if he uses that trick?
I'm prepared for that.
I'm prepared to fight them too.@But I'm not prepared to die, okay?
If you start doing something reckless,@Calvina, I'll stop you.
Don't be ridiculous.@If we lose a lead because of that,@I won't forgive you.
I beat So-Des and avenged everyone,@but something still weighs on me.
Then I'll stop you anyway.@As long as you stay alive, Calvina, I don't care@if you don't forgive me or if you hate me.
That's how prepared I am to fight with you.
...Then back me up properly@so it doesn't come to that.@So neither of us ends up dead.
Roger!
I think so, probably.
If that happens, that one and I@will protect you. So...
Let's win this.
...Never thought I'd hear you@say something so bold.
Then let's go.
Operator
Echo 1, Echo 2, confirmed.
Notify the crew at rear hatch 1.@Hurry and bring in Echo 1 and Echo 2.
Listen, this is when we're most vulnerable.@Work quickly...
Multiple gravity quake readings@at 12 o'clock, elevation 10!
ES Wave Pattern: Fury!
Just what we feared.
So they were waiting for the moment@to finish us off.
Is this the worst possible timing for us,@or...
Rätsel, sir, shall we deploy@the energy field and@withdraw at full speed?
I doubt that would let us escape.@But this time, the situation is different.
You're betting on them?
Yes. We'll launch and target the enemy right after@they teleport in. They'll have countermeasures,@but it'll buy us a little time.
Either way, if we don't win this bet here,@we'll find no chance of victory in the fight@against the Fury to come.
Enemy units about to teleport in!
All units, launch!
Dyna 2 to all units.@Prepare to fire at the enemy's@teleport point.
Hmph, a moment of truth right off the bat.@Sally, you stay back.
I can't do that.
Fairy, you okay?
Yes, no need to worry.@I've mostly figured out what the screens show.
Akimi, the Hyper Blast Sword is usable now,@but the output problem hasn't been@solved. Be careful.
Yeah, I know.
If what comes out is that@black Raftclans from last time...!
Both sides' first moves decide it,@that's how it is.
Rim, we're hitting it with everything we've got.
I know, big brother.
(That girl's hunch was right...@But that's just what I want.)
Mizuho, contact Fiona and Raul.@There's something I need to confirm right away.
Mizuho
Y-Yes, sir!
Gravity quake readings increasing! Here they come!
All units, open fire!
We only took down the Zovorg units?!
They made themselves a wall!
Jua-Mu
Hahahahaha! I knew you'd do that!@That's all you trash can do!
That unit isn't in our data!
That unit's not in our data!
There's no data on that unit!
Then who's piloting it?!
Rätsel!
Right! All units, focus fire on that machine!
Looking back now, I can see that knightly@pride is a load of garbage!
I don't have a shred of hesitation now!@I'll use it! Larseilam!!
Hahahahahaha!@Every last one of you, frozen stiff!!
First up is you, Calvina!@I'll kill you with my own hands!
You'll die without knowing what happened!@Or do you already know?!
But don't worry!@I'll blow your friends and your mothership@to nothing with bombs too!
There's nothing you can do now!@I'm the only one who can move!@I'm the ruler of this space!
Fiona, how's it on your end?!
The Time Turbine is running normally!@We can do this!
Wh-What?! It's moving?!
Raji's theory was right...!@With this Excellence Gunstriker...
we can stand up to him!
Why?! How the hell are you moving?!@This is a stasis field!
For us to survive@the fight against the Fury...
we had no choice but to revive the <Time Flow Engine>,@which can interfere with time particles to an@extent by forcibly spinning the Time Turbine...!
M-Mere Earthlings broke Larseilam?!@Scum like you have that kind of tech?!
No way! Impossible! You're just garbage!@Like hell I'll let this happen!!
It's a reversible turbine...@There's a risk of it running wild,@but it can move inside this field!
We'll teach you that your trick@doesn't work on us anymore!
And I'll show you...@the power of the new Excellence,@the Gunstriker Frame!
Damn it, I can't maintain@the stasis field!
N-Nothing happened?!
He must have used that trick...!
Big brother, look at that!
The Gunstriker's way over there...!
That means... it was able to move, right?
Yes... It seems my theory was correct.
Heh... So we won the bet.
Indeed, splendidly done.
Tch, my output!@After using Larseilam...!
You don't seem to be in good shape.@But relax. I won't kill you. I'll take you alive.
Shut your mouth! Damn it all!!
Hasn't that guy's personality changed a bit?
True...
Perhaps he's at a difficult age.
All units, attack! I'll crush the new model!@Then I can use Larseilam!!
Grrgh! The Coustwell, like this...!@Damn you!!
Nngh!@Fighting without proper output...!
Damn it! If only I could use Larseilam!@If only they weren't here!!
Give it up, Jua-Mu!
C-Calvinaaa!!
I won't kill you...@You're going to tell me about the Fury!@You're going to answer my questions!
Now, give it up!
Ngh, gaaaah!@Like I'd ever beg for my life!
You're not getting away!
There's no need to pursue.@We should take the Kurogane up into space now.
But the leads!
Even if we pursue, it would depend on the@Excellence Gunstriker, which can beat that trick.@That unit should still need adjustments.
That's right.@I pushed it pretty hard just now,@so I'd like to check the Time Flow Engine soon.
No need to rush. That man will@appear before us again.
Right... Yes, he will, without fail...
If you can break Larseilam,@I'll just finish you off here!
Go ahead, use that trick!@Our Excellence can move!@We won't let you do as you please!
Looks like you can't use that trick casually, but@we went for stability! As long as the Time Flow@Engine is running, we can fight!
Damn it! I'll crush you! Crush you right now!!
That's twice you failed to finish me, Jua-Mu!
Shut up, shut up, Calvinaaa!!
New model or not, I'll overpower you@with this Bellzelute Brigandi!
So this is the Gunstriker Frame...@When did you make something like this...
Major Gilliam told us to keep@it completely secret.
You could've at least told us@the <Time Flow Engine> might be able@to handle it, though.
Probably because they didn't want@to confuse us with uncertainties.
Well, if I'd known, I'd probably@have counted on it way too much.
Tsugumi
...So the torso and arms@are from the Striker Frame.
Yes. The lower body and backpack are from@the Gunner Frame, which we'd only designed before.
Gunner and Striker make@Gunstriker, huh...
The Excellence was originally a unit@that swaps between multiple frames, right?
Yes, that's right.
What about Lightning and Eternal?@Those two were supposed to be the top-tier frames.
They were, but this time we had to finish the@unit as fast as possible, and the Time Flow@Engine's stability was the top priority...
So we decided to build two Strikers,@the Excellence's basic frame.
But it lacks versatility,@so we built in parts from the Gunner Frame@and a <Tesla Drive>.
That's why it's more agile than it looks.@Even without the backpack,@the main body can fly on its own.
Hey, didn't you say you'd deleted all@the data on the Time Flow Engine?
Yes, that's right.
Then how...
Did you secretly keep a backup?
No, we didn't.@Even we can't erase the blueprints@in Raji's head and mine...
To give an analogy, it's like sticking a heated@stirrer into water freezing in a glass and@melting it while stirring.
And that stirrer is the Time Flow Engine?
Yes, but in a confined space where time particles@have nearly stopped, only the Excellence@Gunstriker can move...
If three or more Raftclans that can use that trick,@or units like the one just now, appear,@we'll be at a disadvantage.
